title: Crude L^2 bound for translation differences on balls
statement: Let n be a natural number, h : R^n -> R, r, s real numbers and z in R^n with r + |z| <= s, and suppose h is a.e.-strongly measurable for Lebesgue measure restricted to B_s := ball(0,s) in EuclideanSpace R (Fin n). Then int^-_(B_r) |h(x - z) - h(x)|^2 dx <= 4 int^-_(B_s) |h(x)|^2 dx, the integrals being lintegrals of squared extended norms.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : Rn n → ℝ) (r s : ℝ) (z : Rn n), r + ‖z‖ ≤ s → AEStronglyMeasurable h (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) s)) → ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ‖h (x - z) - h x‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) s, ‖h x‖ₑ ^ 2
